def transform(grid):
    """Place the rightmost colored pattern immediately above the lower color-1 pattern."""
    divider = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if row and all(v == 5 for v in row))
    out = [row[:] for row in grid[divider + 1:]]

    target = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(out) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 1]
    tr0, tr1 = min(r for r, c in target), max(r for r, c in target)
    tc0, tc1 = min(c for r, c in target), max(c for r, c in target)

    colors = {v for row in grid[:divider] for v in row if v not in (0, 1, 2, 5)}
    color = max(colors, key=lambda v: max(c for row in grid[:divider] for c, x in enumerate(row) if x == v))
    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid[:divider]) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == color]
    sr0, sr1 = min(r for r, c in cells), max(r for r, c in cells)
    sc0, sc1 = min(c for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)

    height = sr1 - sr0 + 1
    dest_r, dest_c = tr0 - height, tc0
    for r, c in cells:
        rr, cc = dest_r + r - sr0, dest_c + c - sc0
        if 0 <= rr < len(out) and 0 <= cc < len(out[0]):
            out[rr][cc] = color
    return out
